# Code of conduct

Icefin Player adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct.

In short: be respectful, assume good faith, and keep discussion about the work. Harassment, insults and personal attacks are not tolerated in issues, pull requests, discussions or any other project space.

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainer through the contact options on [@Stealthx3](https://github.com/Stealthx3)'s GitHub profile. Reports are handled privately. The maintainer may remove content and restrict or ban participants who break this code.
